CITY OF ALHAMBRA

 NOTICE OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF THE ALHAMBRA YOUTH COMMISSION

  DECEMBER 14, 2021

  (NOTICE NO. N2M21-151)

  CORONAVIRUS (COVID-19) ADVISORY NOTICE
Consistent with AB 361, the Alhambra Youth Commission meeting will not be physically open to
the public, although the public may participate by video conference or teleconference.

To watch and listen to the meeting: To maximize public safety while still maintaining transparency and
public access, members of the public can participate by using Zoom Webinar as follows:
Zoom Webinar direct link:
https://us06web.zoom.us/j/83703890534?pwd=LzRHQzBYVXBLRTlOWWMrWlUxWUFUZz09

Webinar ID: 837 0389 0534, Passcode: commission
Or by telephone by dialing 888-475-4499 (Toll Free) or 833-548-0276 (Toll Free) or 833-548-0282 (Toll
Free) or 877-853-5257 (Toll Free) or 1-253-215-8782 or 1-346-248-7799 or 1-253-215-8782 or 1-646-
558-8656 or 1-301-715-8592 or 1-312-626-6799 and entering Webinar ID: 837 0389 0534 and
Passcode: commission. Please Note: All members of the public calling or logging into the meeting will
be muted so that the meeting can proceed.

For those wishing to speak on an agenda or non-agendized item, you have 3 options for participation:
1) Pre-register to speak: Please email Vincent Hon at vhon@cityofalhambra.org by 5:00 p.m. prior to
the meeting with the item number you wish to speak on and the phone number you will use when
calling or the name you will use when logging into the meeting. You should then call or log into the
meeting at least 10 minutes prior to its start time. Staff will unmute you and announce you when it is
your time to speak. You will have five minutes to speak, unless that time is adjusted by the Recreation
Supervisor. If you do not have access to a computer, please call 626-570-3297 to request public
comment.

2) “Raise your hand”: For those members of the public that wish to speak but did not make a request
via email as described above, such members of the public may speak by using the “Raise Hand” function
during the public comments portion, if on Zoom. Staff will unmute you and announce you when it is your
time to speak. If participating via telephone, the Mayor will ask anyone participating by telephone if they
would like to speak after asking those on Zoom. Staff will unmute telephone callers and you may state
you wish to speak.
3) Emailed comments to be read into the record: As an alternative to speaking during the meeting,
you can email your comments to the Recreation Supervisor at vhon@cityofalhambra.org by no later than
5:00 p.m. on December 14, 2021 to ensure that the Recreation Supervisor has time to print the emails
prior to the beginning of the meeting. Comments will then be read into the record by the Recreation
Supervisor, with a maximum allowance of 5 minutes per individual comment, subject to the Recreation
Supervisor’s discretion. If a comment is received after 5:00 p.m. but before the conclusion of the meeting
based upon its time stamp, the comment will still be included as a part of the record of the meeting but
will not be read into the record.
Any member of the public who needs accommodations or who needs their comments translated should
email or call the Recreation Supervisor at vhon@cityofalhambra.org or (626) 570-3297 who will use their
best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations to provide as much accessibility as possible while
also maintaining public safety.

minutes_text:
APPROVED BY: Youth Commission on January 11, 2022

  Minutes
  Alhambra Youth Commission
  December 14th, 2021

The Alhambra Youth Commission was called to order at 6:00 pm on December 14th, 2021 via
  teleconference and video conference.

Commission Members Present: Gonzalez, Hernandez, Munson, J. Quach, N. Quach, Tran

Commission Members Absent: Andrade, Cooper, Gutierrez, Luc, Oliva, Webster

Also present: Vincent Hon - Recreation Supervisor, Michael Macias – Director of Parks &
Recreation

IV. Discussion Regarding Upcoming Events, i.e., Holiday Home Decorating Contest
Judging, Winter Around the World
Recreation Supervisor Hon announces plans for the Holiday Home Decorating Contest Judging
and how the ranking system will work. Those interested will be emailed the packet to fill out or
print out. Judging can begin as early as Wednesday and packets will need to be submitted to the
Alhambra Park Office by Monday at 4 pm. The Winter Wonderland will be Sat Jan22 on 2nd St.
Mr. Hon goes on to explain that this event will encompass various cultures from around the
world and the ways they celebrate winter holidays. He continues to explain that there will be arts
and crafts, various food vendors, and a wide array of musical talent to play at the event.
Commission participation is not required but will be appreciated, and commissioners are still
encouraged to come out to the event with family as it is the first of its kind.

V. Discussion Regarding Community Engagement with the Seniors at Joslyn - What ideas
have we come up with? Tech Talk Starting January 2022
Mr. Hon begins by notifying the group that the Joslyn Center will be starting their Tech Talks
and have asked if the Youth Commission would like to participate. Some ideas to help promote
the youth commission engagement are, flyers set around the senior center, bulletin boards, and
ads in Alhambra newspaper/media. Mr. Hon asks for the group to better elaborate on the
proposed; Adopt a Senior program, and what it will entail, i.e. arts and crafts, assistance
technology, casual talks (possibly over coffee). Recreation Director Mike Macias adds, reaching
out to the Senior Center to get an estimate if and which Seniors would be interested in these
programs.
 VI. Discussion Regarding Youth Summit - Status and Touring the Facility
Youth Commission President N. Quach recounts the previous meeting and the ideas for the
Youth Summit submitted then which include but are not limited to, food vendors, college
application assistance booth, college recruiters, resume building workshops, sponsors, and
participation by various different school/extracurricular clubs. Commissioner N. Quach also
proposed having a department head panel in which the speakers would be various city
department leaders come out and speak to the youth in attendance. He also adds some potential
categories for the Youth awards. Mr. Hon has asked that the youth commission consider moving
the date towards March, to give sufficient time to contact and coordinate with the different
groups involved. Commissioners are also encouraged to reach out to potential vendors as well
and have them reach out to the City. Mr. Hon. adds that the youth commission should take into
account that the potential vendors will be viewing their participation from a business standpoint,
as they will consider how much they are expected to sell/make as well as what if any fee will be
required to attend the event.

VII. Oral Communications
No Oral Commission Orals at this time.

VIII. Commission Orals
Commission B. Gonzalez proposes reaching out to the skate park activist group which attended
the last Youth Commission meeting to participate in future ones. This may help give them an
outlet to adjust and fine-tune the proposal they will submit to the City Council. Youth
Commission President N. Quach proposes having the skate park group attend and speak at the
January meeting to present their ideas and progress. He would also like to appoint a Board of
Education Member to the Youth Commission and act as an outlet to notify the group of current
events and topics relating to the youth of Alhambra

X. Adjournment
The meeting is adjourned at 7:15 pm.
